text: 宽基指数的风格细分布局又迈出关键一步。11月13日，易方达基金、华夏基金、国泰基金、广发基金、招商基金、博时基金等头部公募扎堆上报的中证A500成长ETF，申报材料已获证监会接收。这一批新产品，是市场在中证A500基础宽基之上，专门为成长风格打造的指数工具，补齐了A500系列的成长拼图。（券商中国）
text_en: The style segmentation of broad-based indices has taken another key step. On November 13, CSI A500 Growth ETFs jointly reported by leading public fund managers including E Fund, China AMC, Guotai Fund, GF Fund, China Merchants Fund and Bosera Fund had their filing materials accepted by the CSRC. This batch of new products is an index tool built specifically for the growth style on top of the CSI A500 broad-based index, completing the growth piece of the A500 series. (Brokerage China)
